plugins.name: goodesign
plugins.description: Three skills. goodesign: one design skill with an index built for agents — atomic files per topic, read on demand; flow, space, type, colour, states, motion, forms, copy; terminal UI; the Apple lineage; the AI-slop blacklist; review passes, a ship gate and a page audit; four wearable personas. diw-use-customer-identity: how a brand's own law rides on goodesign — precedence, the shape of a brand instance, a brand gate stacked on goodesign's, authoring an instance from a token home. diw-ci-manola: the Manola brand as that instance.
